name: ModelPart
lead: A named group of boxes that turns around its pivot. Units are 16 to the block, the origin is the model's bottom centre, and a box reaches -24..24.

functions.name: part
functions.signature: modelPart:part(name: string, opts: { pivot: Vec3 ? }?) → ModelPart
functions.description: Makes a child part of this one; it turns around `pivot`, the model's origin unless you give one.

functions.name: box
functions.signature: modelPart:box(from: Vec3, to: Vec3, skin: ModelSkin, opts: { rotation: Vec3 ?, pivot: Vec3 ?, faces: { [Face]: ModelSkin }?, }?)
functions.description: Corners in any order; a box turns on one axis, in steps of 22.5 up to 45, and `pivot` is the box's own centre unless you give one.

functions.name: hitbox
functions.description: A box a player can hit on a living body that wears the model (clients from 1.19.4). Not drawn; corners in any order, in model units. Square from above (its longer side), so split a long part. Animations do not move it. A model with none is hit on one box of the body's `size`.

functions.name: mirror
functions.description: A mirrored copy of every box and hitbox this part has, and a mirrored twin named `<name>_mirrored` of every child. Only "x" in this version.

title: ModelPart type
